name: Cash Account Service
definition: Services linked to an account which are available to the account owner or to the holder of a mandate. The exercise of these services may be submitted to a limit.

CompensationMethod.name: Compensation Method
CompensationMethod.definition: Defines if and how charges and taxes due are paid to the account servicer.

BillingCurrency.name: Billing Currency
BillingCurrency.definition: Currency used for billing the services related to the account.

BillingChargeMethod.name: Billing Charge Method
BillingChargeMethod.definition: Defines how the billing charge is calculated.

PaymentMethod.name: Payment Method
PaymentMethod.definition: Specifies the different payment methods for an account service.

CashAccountMandate.name: Cash Account Mandate
CashAccountMandate.definition: Mandate which specifies the services that can be operated by the mandate holder.

CashAccountContract.name: Cash Account Contract
CashAccountContract.definition: Cash account contract which specifies the services linked to a cash account. It is derived from the association between AccountService and AccountContract.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Cash account for which services are specified. It is derived from the association between AccountService and Account.
